definitions.explanation: To fail to remember something, or to leave something behind unintentionally.

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}を{忘|わす}れてしまいました。
{傘|かさ}を{電車|でんしゃ}に{忘|わす}れました。
examples.english: I left my umbrella on the train.

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}を{忘|わす}れないでください。

notes: An ichidan verb. Often used with てしまう to express regret: {忘|わす}れてしまった (unfortunately forgot). {忘|わす}れ{物|もの} means 'forgotten item' or 'lost property'. Related: {忘年会|ぼうねんかい} (year-end party, literally 'forget-the-year gathering').
